learned_arms.direct_mlp: Unstructured capacity control predicting m_t+1 directly
learned_arms.physical_tau: Predict m_inf(V) and positive tau(V), then apply the exponential solver
learned_arms.direct_z: Predict bounded m_inf(V) and z(V,dt), then apply a convex update

reference_arms.linear_rate_lut: Linear interpolation of m_inf and log(tau) sampled only on fit voltages

fairness.seed_policy: learning rate and checkpoint selected by mean development score across all three seeds; no seed selection

interpretation.positive: The held-voltage m-gate primitive is atomically learnable under the registered budget.
interpretation.negative: Failure localizes the problem to representation or optimization before any coupled-neuron experiment.
interpretation.forbidden_claim: No result from this task establishes sufficiency under a varying or endogenous voltage path.
